text:
Maria Chen: Quick check — proposing we standardize on gRPC + protobuf for internal S2S, and keep JSON/REST at the public edge. Thoughts on gateway shape? :thinking:

Raj Patel: Strong +1 for proto internal. Main question is gateway shape: one smart gateway that handles transcoding, quotas, rollouts, etc., or tiny passthrough + per-service sidecars? Latency/cost tradeoffs.

Jordan Lee: For high QPS routes passthrough sidecars reduce a hop and keep p99s lower. But we lose a single control plane for quota enforcement and rollout signals.

Casey Gomez: From console/UX POV we want a single place to surface quota usage and canary rollouts. If we go sidecars we need an aggregator to show per-route + per-tenant metrics.

Maria Chen: What about hybrid: edge gateway for auth/ratelimit/routing policy, sidecars for protocol adapt and local enforcement. Gateway delegates enforcement when config says 'local-enforce=true'.

Raj Patel: Can the telemetry/metrics pipeline handle that without double counting? Concern: metrics duplication and attribution — console needs per-tenant cost and token counts.

Jordan Lee: We can propagate a deterministic trace_id and a route attribution header from the gateway. Sidecars emit metrics with that tag. Aggregation layer dedups by trace_id and aggregates attribution.

Casey Gomez: Rollout UX requirement: console must allow canary toggles that flip between 'gateway-transcode' and 'passthrough' variants and show success rate, latency, and error breakdown per variant.

deploy-bot: deploy hook: canary policy added to 'routing' config. preview: /deploy-preview 176999-rtg1

Maria Chen: Quick config I prototyped locally:
```yaml
routing:
  default: gateway
  canaries:
    - name: passthrough-small
      match: header:X-Canary
      target: sidecar
      percent: 5
```

Raj Patel: Also we need a clear schema-evolution playbook for protos. We can't force proto-first on all consumer teams. Proposal: require proto contracts for internal RPCs and provide generated REST adapters for external-facing endpoints.

Jordan Lee: Agreed. Also consider using Envoy ext_authz + rate limit gRPC service to centralize quota checks without owning all logic in the gateway.

Casey Gomez: Action items: 1) write up a short proposal for hybrid gateway + sidecar pattern (ownership, config, failure modes). 2) define telemetry contract (trace keys, attribution headers, dedupe rules). 3) console mock for canary UX showing variant metrics. I can start the mock.

Maria Chen: Thanks — Raj/Jordan can you run quick perf tests (synthetic qps/latency) for both full-gateway and passthrough + sidecar patterns and post numbers? If no objections by EOD Friday I'll spin up an RFC doc.

Raj Patel: Will run perf-suite tomorrow morning and post results in this thread.

Jordan Lee: I'll sketch the envoy+sidecar config and flag pitfalls (connection churn, TLS termination).

Casey Gomez: I'll post the initial console wire by Wednesday.

Maria Chen: Great — let's reconvene after the perf numbers. :thumbsup:
